security_policy_layer: Use a dedicated management VLAN or equivalent isolated management segment when exact topology/device support is verified.
Prefer encrypted management protocols such as HTTPS/SSH/SNMPv3 when the exact product supports them.
Do not enable insecure or unnecessary management services merely for convenience.
Do not expose controller/device management directly to untrusted networks without an explicit, reviewed access-control design.
Keep portal/client access paths distinct from controller administration paths.
Do not persist passwords, tokens, private keys or certificate private-key material in logs or reports.
pre_change_guards: verify alternate recovery path where available
capture compatible backup before risky management-plane changes
compute exact impact on controller-device reachability
pass_requires: controller login reachable through intended path
unnecessary management exposure absent according to approved policy
